description: Source file implementing nghttp2 callback functions for HTTP/2 frame handling, including frame processing, error handling, and callback registration.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is ready to be sent over the network, calls visitor->OnReadyToSend and handles return codes.

methods.name: OnBeginFrame
methods.description: Callback invoked at the start of a frame, processes frame header and invokes visitor methods accordingly.

methods.name: OnFrameReceived
methods.description: Handles received frames, dispatches to appropriate visitor methods based on frame type.

methods.name: OnBeginHeaders
methods.description: Called at the start of headers, invokes visitor->OnBeginHeadersForStream.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Processes individual header fields, calls visitor->OnHeaderForStream and handles callback results.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Called before a frame is sent, logs and invokes visitor->OnBeforeFrameSent.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Called after a frame is sent, calls visitor->OnFrameSent with frame details.

methods.name: OnFrameNotSent
methods.description: Handles failure to send a frame, calls source->OnFailure for extension frames.

methods.name: OnDataChunk
methods.description: Handles data chunks received for a stream, calls visitor->OnDataForStream.

methods.name: OnExtensionChunkReceived
methods.description: Processes received extension frames, calls visitor->OnMetadataForStream.

methods.name: OnUnpackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Handles unpacking of extension frames, calls visitor->OnMetadataEndForStream.

methods.name: OnPackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Handles packing of extension frames, calls source->Pack.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles errors during frame processing, calls visitor->OnErrorDebug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes nghttp2 session callbacks, sets all callback functions.
